title: Set Membership Estimation for Stochastic Linear Contextual Bandits
summary: Contextual bandit learning has attracted increasing attention in engineering applications due to its ability to incorporate side/context information in time-varying environments. A widely used approach for contextual bandits is optimism in the face of uncertainty (OFU), in which uncertainty sets for unknown parameters are constructed and decisions are made optimistically over these sets. In the bandit literature, uncertainty sets are typically derived using statistical learning tools, such as confidence intervals.
